nodes.label: add_mailbox_inbox/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration creating the Mailbox and LeadStatusHistory tables plus a Reply messageId unique index for inbound IMAP sync.

nodes.label: Mailbox
nodes.summary: IMAP mailbox config (label, email, imapHost/port, useSsl, username, appPassword, enabled, syncIntervalSec, last-sync state, lastSeenUid/uidValidity, totalImported) for inbox syncing.

nodes.label: LeadStatusHistory
nodes.summary: Status-transition log for a Lead (campaignId, domainId, fromStatus, toStatus, reason, source).

nodes.label: add_auth_multi_tenancy/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Large auth/multi-tenancy migration (208 lines) adding Session, PasswordResetToken, VerificationToken, OAuthAccount, UserSettings, NotificationPreference and Integration tables plus per-user uniqueness/scoping indexes across existing tables.

nodes.label: Session
nodes.summary: Refresh-token session (tokenHash, userAgent, ip, expiresAt, revokedAt) for a User.

nodes.label: PasswordResetToken
nodes.summary: Single-use password reset token (tokenHash, expiresAt, usedAt) for a User.

nodes.label: VerificationToken
nodes.summary: Email-verification token (tokenHash, expiresAt, usedAt) for a User.

nodes.label: OAuthAccount
nodes.summary: Linked OAuth identity (provider, providerAccountId) for a User.

nodes.label: UserSettings
nodes.summary: Per-user preferences (displayName, aiTone, defaultEmailStyle, preferredModel, pricingStrategy, portfolioCategories, outreach/followUp defaults, buyerScoringPrefs, onboardingComplete).

nodes.label: NotificationPreference
nodes.summary: Per-user notification settings (desktop, email, campaignAlerts, replyAlerts).

nodes.label: Integration
nodes.summary: Third-party integration record (provider, status, healthStatus, lastVerifiedAt) scoped to a User.

nodes.label: add_watchlist/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration creating the domain-watchlist schema: WatchedDomain, WatchedDomainEvent, WatchlistReminder and WatchlistNotification tables plus indexes.

nodes.label: WatchedDomain
nodes.summary: User-tracked target domain (domainName, priority, status, brand/market/acquisition scores, estimatedValue, AI recommendation/reasoning, registrationStatus, registrar, expirationDate, lastCheckedAt, isFavorite).

nodes.label: WatchedDomainEvent
nodes.summary: Event log entry for a WatchedDomain (type, details).

nodes.label: WatchlistReminder
nodes.summary: Scheduled reminder for a watched domain (type, label, triggerAt, triggered/triggeredAt, notifyVia).

nodes.label: WatchlistNotification
nodes.summary: User-facing watchlist notification (domainName, type, title, body, priority, read/readAt).

nodes.label: add_contact_intelligence/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Small migration adding contact-intelligence columns/indexes to Lead (bestContactChannel, whatsappScore indexes).

nodes.label: add_emaillog_variant/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Tiny migration adding an EmailLog variant index for A/B-test variant tracking.

nodes.label: add_decision_maker_fields/migration.sql
nodes.summary: Migration adding decision-maker and scoring columns/indexes to Lead (priorityScore, buyerIntentScore, decisionMakerRole, decisionMakerScore indexes).
